premise: Ladybug wants to count everyone's spots, but Deer bends to graze, Frog snaps up a fly and Mushroom gets the giggles, so she keeps losing count; Duckling has no spots at all — "ONE Duckling!" — and that gives her the idea of counting friends instead.
inspiration: Folk counting rhymes and the uncountable-stars motif, turned into a giggle: the one thing that never wiggles out of the count is your friends.
lesson: Everyone counts, spots or no spots.

en-US.title: Ladybug Counts the Spots
en-US.text: {ladybug:enter} Ladybug loved counting. [excited] First, her own spots. One, two, three, four, five… SIX! {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} Easy! Next, {deer:enter} Deer's spots, lots of little white ones. {ladybug:go to deer} Over she crawled. One, two, thr… but Deer {deer:live graze} bent down for a nibble. {ladybug:face surprised} [gasps] "Oh no! Lost count!" Then {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog's spots, over by the pond. {ladybug:go to frog by fly} {sfx:whirr} Ladybug flew across. [whispers] "Hold still, please." {frog:live catch-fly hold} Frog froze. One, two, three… {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} SNAP! Frog caught a fly. [laughs] "Lost count AGAIN!" So up she flew onto {mushroom:enter} {ladybug:go on mushroom by fly} Mushroom's spotty red cap. But her little feet tickled, and Mushroom {mushroom:live laugh} got the giggles. {ladybug:face sad} Lost count, three times! Along waddled {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to mushroom} Duckling. "Count mine!" Ladybug looked. Fluff, fluff, and more fluff. {duckling:face sad} Not one spot. [playfully] "Then you're the easiest of all," said Ladybug. "ONE Duckling!" {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} {ladybug:face happy} That gave her an idea. They counted friends instead. "Ladybug, one! Deer, two! Frog, three! Mushroom, four! Duckling, five!" {all:face happy} {ladybug:live wings} Ladybug fluttered her wings and took a bow. [happily] And not one of them wiggled… much.

es-ES.title: Mariquita cuenta lunares
es-ES.text: {ladybug:enter} A Mariquita le encantaba contar. [excited] Primero, sus lunares: uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco… ¡y SEIS! {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} ¡Chupado! Luego, los de {deer:enter} Ciervo, que tenía un montón. {ladybug:go to deer} Allá que fue. Uno, dos, tr… pero Ciervo {deer:live graze} se agachó a pastar. {ladybug:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Ay, he perdido la cuenta! Pues los de {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana, junto a la charca. {ladybug:go to frog by fly} {sfx:whirr} Mariquita fue volando. [whispers] —Quieta, por favor. {frog:live catch-fly hold} Rana se quedó como una estatua. Uno, dos, tres… {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} ¡ZAS! Rana se zampó una mosca. [laughs] —¡OTRA VEZ! Así que voló al sombrero de {mushroom:enter} {ladybug:go on mushroom by fly} Seta, rojo y con lunares. Pero sus patitas le hacían cosquillas, y Seta {mushroom:live laugh} se echó a reír. {ladybug:face sad} ¡Y van tres! Llegó {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to mushroom} Patito, bamboleándose. —¡Cuenta los míos! Mariquita miró y remiró. Pelusa, pelusa y más pelusa. {duckling:face sad} Ni un lunar. [playfully] —¡Facilísimo! —dijo Mariquita—. ¡UN Patito! {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} {ladybug:face happy} Entonces tuvo una idea: ¡contar amigos! —¡Mariquita, uno! ¡Ciervo, dos! ¡Rana, tres! ¡Seta, cuatro! ¡Patito, cinco! {all:face happy} {ladybug:live wings} Mariquita abrió las alas e hizo una reverencia. [happily] Y nadie se movió… casi.

ja-JP.title: テントウムシさんの かぞえっこ
ja-JP.text: {ladybug:enter}テントウムシさんは、かぞえるのが大すき。[excited]まずは、じぶんのてんてん。いち、に、さん、し、ご…ろく！{ladybug:face happy}{ladybug:hop}「かんたん！」 つぎは、{deer:enter}子ジカの白いてんてん。いっぱいです。{ladybug:go to deer}ちょこちょこ…いち、に、さ…あれ、子ジカが{deer:live graze}くさをもぐもぐ。{ladybug:face surprised}[gasps]「あーん、わからなくなっちゃった！」 こんどは、{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}池のカエルさん。{ladybug:go to frog by fly}{sfx:whirr}ぶーん。[whispers]「うごかないでね」 {frog:live catch-fly hold}カエルさんは、ぴたっ。いち、に、さん…{frog:live catch-fly resume}{sfx:snap}ぱくっ！ハエをつかまえました。[laughs]「また、わからなくなっちゃった！」 そこで{mushroom:enter}{ladybug:go on mushroom by fly}キノコの、てんてんもようの赤いかさへ、ぶーん。でも、あしがくすぐったくて、キノコは{mushroom:live laugh}くすくすくす。{ladybug:face sad}これで、さんかいめ！そこへ{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to mushroom}アヒルの子が、よちよち。「ぼくのも、かぞえて！」 じーっと見ると…ふわふわ、ふわふわ、ふわふわばかり。{duckling:face sad}てんてんは、ひとつもなし。[playfully]「じゃあ、いちばんかんたん。アヒルの子が…ひとり！」 {duckling:face happy}{duckling:hop x2}{ladybug:face happy}そうだ！おともだちをかぞえよう。「テントウムシさん、いち！子ジカ、に！カエルさん、さん！キノコ、よん！アヒルの子、ご！」 {all:face happy}{ladybug:live wings}テントウムシさんは、はねをぱたぱた、ぺこり。[happily]だれもうごきませんでした…ほとんどね。

de-DE.title: Der Marienkäfer zählt Punkte
de-DE.text: {ladybug:enter} Der Marienkäfer zählte für sein Leben gern. [excited] Zuerst seine eigenen Punkte. Eins, zwei, drei, vier, fünf… SECHS! {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} Kinderleicht! Als Nächstes {deer:enter} das Reh, mit lauter kleinen weißen Punkten. {ladybug:go to deer} Schnell krabbelte er hinüber. Eins, zwei, dr… aber das Reh {deer:live graze} beugte sich zum Grasen hinunter. {ladybug:face surprised} [gasps] „Oh nein! Verzählt!“ Dann {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} der Frosch mit seinen Punkten, drüben am Teich. {ladybug:go to frog by fly} {sfx:whirr} Der Marienkäfer flog hinüber. [whispers] „Bitte ganz still halten.“ {frog:live catch-fly hold} Der Frosch erstarrte. Eins, zwei, drei… {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} SCHNAPP! Der Frosch hatte sich eine Fliege geschnappt. [laughs] „Schon WIEDER verzählt!“ Also flog er hinauf auf {mushroom:enter} {ladybug:go on mushroom by fly} den Pilz mit dem rot gepunkteten Hut. Aber seine kleinen Füße kitzelten, und der Pilz {mushroom:live laugh} musste kichern. {ladybug:face sad} Dreimal verzählt! Da kam {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to mushroom} das Entchen angewatschelt. „Zähl meine!“ Der Marienkäfer schaute. Flaum, Flaum und noch mehr Flaum. {duckling:face sad} Kein einziger Punkt. [playfully] „Dann bist du am allerleichtesten“, sagte der Marienkäfer. „EIN Entchen!“ {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} {ladybug:face happy} Da hatte er eine Idee: Sie zählten einfach Freunde. „Marienkäfer, eins! Reh, zwei! Frosch, drei! Pilz, vier! Entchen, fünf!“ {all:face happy} {ladybug:live wings} Der Marienkäfer flatterte mit den Flügeln und verbeugte sich. [happily] Und keiner wackelte… na ja, fast keiner.

fr-FR.title: Coccinelle compte les points
fr-FR.text: {ladybug:enter} Coccinelle adorait compter. [excited] D’abord, ses propres points. Un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq… SIX ! {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} Facile ! Ensuite, les taches de {deer:enter} Faon, plein de petites taches blanches. {ladybug:go to deer} Elle a trottiné jusqu’à lui. Un, deux, tr… mais Faon {deer:live graze} s’est penché pour brouter. {ladybug:face surprised} [gasps] « Oh non ! J’ai perdu le compte ! » Alors, les taches de {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Grenouille, là-bas, près de la mare. {ladybug:go to frog by fly} {sfx:whirr} Coccinelle a traversé en volant. [whispers] « Ne bouge plus, s’il te plaît. » {frog:live catch-fly hold} Grenouille s’est figée. Un, deux, trois… {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} CLAC ! Grenouille a attrapé une mouche. [laughs] « Encore perdu ! » Alors elle s’est envolée sur {mushroom:enter} {ladybug:go on mushroom by fly} Champignon, sur son chapeau rouge à pois. Mais ses petites pattes le chatouillaient, et Champignon {mushroom:live laugh} a attrapé le fou rire. {ladybug:face sad} Perdu, trois fois ! {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to mushroom} Caneton est arrivé en se dandinant. « Compte les miennes ! » Coccinelle a regardé. Du duvet, du duvet, et encore du duvet. {duckling:face sad} Pas une seule tache. [playfully] « Alors c’est toi le plus facile, a dit Coccinelle. UN Caneton ! » {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} {ladybug:face happy} Ça lui a donné une idée : et si on comptait les amis, plutôt ? « Coccinelle, un ! Faon, deux ! Grenouille, trois ! Champignon, quatre ! Caneton, cinq ! » {all:face happy} {ladybug:live wings} Coccinelle a ouvert ses ailes et fait la révérence. [happily] Et personne n’a bougé… ou presque.

it-IT.title: Coccinella conta i puntini
it-IT.text: {ladybug:enter} Coccinella adorava contare. [excited] Prima i suoi puntini: uno, due, tre, quattro, cinque… SEI! {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} Facilissimo! Poi i puntini di {deer:enter} Cerbiatto, tante macchioline bianche. {ladybug:go to deer} Coccinella è andata da lui. Uno, due, tr… ma Cerbiatto {deer:live graze} si è chinato a brucare. {ladybug:face surprised} [gasps] «Oh no! Ho perso il conto!» Allora i puntini di {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana, laggiù allo stagno. {ladybug:go to frog by fly} {sfx:whirr} Coccinella è volata fin là. [whispers] «Ferma, per favore.» {frog:live catch-fly hold} Rana è rimasta immobile. Uno, due, tre… {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} Zac! Gnam! Rana ha preso una mosca. [laughs] «Ho perso il conto DI NUOVO!» Così è volata su {mushroom:enter} {ladybug:go on mushroom by fly} Fungo, sul suo cappello rosso a puntini. Ma le sue zampette gli facevano il solletico, e Fungo {mushroom:live laugh} si è messo a ridere. {ladybug:face sad} Tre volte su tre: conto perso! Ecco arrivare {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to mushroom} Anatroccolo, dondolando. «Conta i miei!» Coccinella ha guardato bene. Piumino, piumino e ancora piumino. {duckling:face sad} Neanche un puntino. [playfully] «Allora sei il più facile di tutti», ha detto Coccinella. «UN Anatroccolo!» {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} {ladybug:face happy} E le è venuta un'idea: contare gli amici! «Coccinella, uno! Cerbiatto, due! Rana, tre! Fungo, quattro! Anatroccolo, cinque!» {all:face happy} {ladybug:live wings} Coccinella ha agitato le alucce e ha fatto un inchino. [happily] E nessuno si è mosso… o quasi.

zh-TW.title: 瓢蟲數點點
zh-TW.text: {ladybug:enter}瓢蟲最喜歡數數了。[excited]先數自己的點點：一、二、三、四、五……六！{ladybug:face happy}{ladybug:hop}好簡單！接下來，數{deer:enter}小鹿身上白白的小點點。{ladybug:go to deer}牠爬了過去。一、二、三……可是小鹿{deer:live graze}低下頭吃草了。{ladybug:face surprised}[gasps]「哎呀！數亂了！」 再來是{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙的點點，牠在池塘邊。{ladybug:go to frog by fly}{sfx:whirr}瓢蟲飛了過去。[whispers]「請不要動喔。」 {frog:live catch-fly hold}青蛙一動也不動。一、二、三……{frog:live catch-fly resume}{sfx:snap}啪！青蛙抓到一隻蒼蠅。[laughs]「又數亂了啦！」 於是，瓢蟲飛上{mushroom:enter}{ladybug:go on mushroom by fly}蘑菇紅紅的、有點點的菇傘。可是牠的小腳搔得蘑菇好癢，蘑菇{mushroom:live laugh}咯咯笑。{ladybug:face sad}三次都數亂了！{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to mushroom}小鴨搖搖擺擺地走過來。「數我的！」 瓢蟲看了又看。毛茸茸、毛茸茸，全都是毛茸茸。{duckling:face sad}一個點點也沒有。[playfully]「那你最好數啦！」 瓢蟲說，「一隻小鴨！」 {duckling:face happy}{duckling:hop x2}{ladybug:face happy}瓢蟲想到一個好主意：不數點點，來數朋友！「瓢蟲，一！小鹿，二！青蛙，三！蘑菇，四！小鴨，五！」 {all:face happy}{ladybug:live wings}瓢蟲拍拍翅膀，鞠了一個躬。[happily]而且，大家都沒有亂動……嗯，差不多啦。

zh-HK.title: 瓢蟲數點點
zh-HK.text: {ladybug:enter}瓢蟲最喜歡數數。[excited]首先，數自己的點點：一、二、三、四、五……六！{ladybug:face happy}{ladybug:hop}太容易了！接着，數{deer:enter}小鹿的點點——小鹿身上有好多白色的小點點。{ladybug:go to deer}瓢蟲爬了過去。一、二、三……可是小鹿{deer:live graze}低頭吃草去了。{ladybug:face surprised}[gasps]「哎呀！唔記得數到邊喇！」 然後是{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙的點點，青蛙就在池塘邊。{ladybug:go to frog by fly}{sfx:whirr}瓢蟲飛了過去。[whispers]「唔該你，唔好郁呀。」 {frog:live catch-fly hold}青蛙定住了，一動也不動。一、二、三……{frog:live catch-fly resume}{sfx:snap}啪！青蛙捉住了一隻蒼蠅。[laughs]「又數亂咗！」 於是瓢蟲飛上{mushroom:enter}{ladybug:go on mushroom by fly}蘑菇那頂有點點的紅帽子。可是牠的小腳搔得蘑菇癢癢的，蘑菇{mushroom:live laugh}咯咯地笑起來。{ladybug:face sad}數了三次，三次都數亂了！{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to mushroom}小鴨一搖一擺地走過來。「數吓我嘅！」 瓢蟲看呀看。絨毛，絨毛，全身都是黃色的絨毛。{duckling:face sad}一粒點點也沒有。[playfully]「噉你最易數喇！」 瓢蟲說，「一隻小鴨！」 {duckling:face happy}{duckling:hop x2}{ladybug:face happy}瓢蟲想到一個好主意：不數點點了，改數朋友！「瓢蟲，一！小鹿，二！青蛙，三！蘑菇，四！小鴨，五！」 {all:face happy}{ladybug:live wings}瓢蟲拍拍翅膀，鞠了一個躬。[happily]大家都沒有亂動……嗯，只是動了一點點。

whirr.prompt: a ladybug's tiny wings whirring as it takes off, very light and close

snap.prompt: a quick wet comic tongue flick and a tiny gulp, playful
